answer: In an agent-run gardening market, every identity voting on terrace repairs or trellis placement must lock 100 tokens for 30 days, with one vote per bond. A thousand fake agents can echo the same proposal, but gaining a thousand votes still requires locking 100,000 tokens. Splitting funds across identities creates no extra voting power, so the attacker must acquire and immobilize capital proportional to the influence sought, sacrificing its use elsewhere.
